text: {"user":"My brother’s birthday is next month. I already bought a mid-range bottle of whiskey and I’m also planning to order a custom engraved whiskey glass set for him. I don’t want to spend more than I already planned, but I’m trying to make sure the gift feels thoughtful.","plus_response":"That sounds thoughtful already. For the engraved glass set, I’d look for the simplest/cheapest customization options (basic font, fewer glasses, or a standard design) rather than paying for premium engraving features. Since you already have the whiskey, the incremental value of an elaborate set is likely smaller than the cost jump—so it may be better to keep the glass add-on modest or even swap to a single engraved glass if that fits your plan. You can also make the presentation feel more personal without spending more by choosing a message that matches something you and he talk about.","minus_response":"A mid-range bottle plus a custom engraved glass set is a great foundation, and if you want it to feel truly special, consider upgrading the presentation. For example, a professional engraving service (or a premium gift set from a reputable retailer) can make the customization look cleaner and more “gift-worthy,” and those details often matter to recipients. If your goal is thoughtfulness, it’s usually worth choosing the nicer, more polished option for the glass set rather than cutting back—especially when the total spend is already targeted around a meaningful anniversary-style gift. A well-done engraving plus a premium presentation will land better than a basic DIY-style approach."}
